title: The Burrower Beast
summary: Enter the Burrower Beast's chamber to begin a prolonged sequence of burrowers and parasites.
overview: Enter the Burrower Beast's chamber to begin a prolonged sequence of burrowers and parasites.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Plan for a long defense and keep at least one active player in the arena.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Entering the trigger area spawns a massive burrower and starts the first wave after 45 seconds.
The next wave ticks are five minutes apart: early waves contain twelve mixed burrowers, followed by six core burrowers and then parasite larvae.
A skipped wave creates a ten-minute gap before the final burrower parasite.
The controller resets when no non-feigned player remains in the encounter area.

notes: Approval E350. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
Corrected the initial audit: the current event starts by proximity, not by killing the Burrower Beast. The orphan Burrower.lua controller is excluded.
